title.description: Main experience title shown in the hero and page metadata.

partner.description: Optional internal link to the partner entry when that content model is in use.

short_description.description: Short sales-focused summary used in the about section and SEO fallback.

price_display.description: Exact visible price text, for example 42 EUR or From 42 EUR.

duration.description: Visible duration label, for example 180min or 3.5 hours.

included_items.description: One included item per line. Used in the included list if no blok items are present.

images.description: Hero/gallery images. The first image is used as the main hero image.

shopify_product_handle.description: Optional Shopify product handle for future booking integration.

availability_notes.description: Short urgency or booking note, for example Usually booked 2-3 days in advance.

bokun_experience_id.description: Optional Bokun experience identifier for future booking integration.

availability_widget.description: Paste a booking URL or iframe/embed code. If a URL is found, the CTA will link to it.

seo_title.description: Optional SEO title override. Falls back to Title if empty.

seo_description.description: Optional SEO description override. Falls back to Short Description if empty.

location.description: Visible destination text in the hero meta row.

reviews_count.description: Visible number of reviews, for example 124.

group_type.description: Visible group type label, for example Small group or Private tour.

trust_text.description: Trust copy shown near the description. Use one short point per line if needed.

urgency_text.description: Short urgency line below the main CTA.

facts.description: Quick facts list. Add Fact Item blocks with label and value.

not_included_items.description: One excluded item per line. Used in the not included list if no blok items are present.

itinerary.description: Itinerary steps. Add Itinerary Item blocks with time, title, and description.

guide_name.description: Guide or host name shown in the guide section.

guide_description.description: Short guide bio shown in the guide section.

guide_image.description: Optional portrait for the guide section.

reviews.description: Guest reviews. Add Review Item blocks with name, rating, and text.

highlights.description: Short highlight chips used in the Why this experience area.

partner_label.description: Visible partner line in the hero meta row. Optional, falls back to default if empty.

verification_label.description: Visible verification line in the hero meta row. Optional, falls back to default if empty.

price_label.description: Label shown above the price, for example Starting price.

price_suffix.description: Text shown after or below the price, for example per person.

why_section_title.description: Section heading for the highlights area.

about_section_title.description: Section heading for the description area.

facts_section_title.description: Section heading for the quick facts card.

sustainability_section_title.description: Section heading for the sustainability area.

sustainability_intro.description: Optional intro sentence above the sustainability bullet points.

included_section_title.description: Section heading for the inclusion area.

included_label.description: Subheading above the included items list.

not_included_label.description: Subheading above the not included items list.

itinerary_section_title.description: Section heading for the itinerary area.

reviews_section_title.description: Section heading for the reviews area.

guide_section_title.description: Section heading for the guide area.

years_guiding_label.description: Label under the guide years stat.

happy_travelers_label.description: Label under the happy travelers stat.

related_section_title.description: Section heading for the related experiences area.

related_experiences.description: Pick up to 3 real experience entries to show in the related experiences section.
